messages:
tori-cs: Heads-up — SundanceRetail has a LATAM pilot scheduled Thu 11:00 UTC. Theyre asking for a short regional surge for partner demos and need a header + accelerator CIDR allowlist so their edge can sign calls. Renewal flagged as medium-risk if demo has auth or latency issues.

marc-ops: Thanks. What multiplier and duration? Header format and CIDR? Which region should we prefer?

tori-cs: Product wants +3x baseline QPS for 2.5 hours (2026-10-07T11:00:00Z -> 2026-10-07T13:30:00Z). Header: X-SD-Auth with tokens like sd_live-<6-10 alnum>. CIDR for their accelerator: 192.0.2.128/25. Route to sa-east-1 primarily, fallback to us-east-1 only if capacity constrained. Also request a fallback to a compact quantized model when p95 latency > 360ms for 90s. Auto-revoke after window. Please set account renewal_flag=medium.

yasmin-eng: We can do header regex ^sd_live-[A-Za-z0-9]{6,10}$. Will implement combined allowlist where header OR CIDR authorized. Compact model available: sundance-compact-q4_0. Suggest fallback trigger: p95 > 360ms sustained 90s OR 5xx_rate > 1.2% for 2m. Recommend ephemeral small pool bump to reduce tail latency during the demo.

marc-ops: Drafting CR and runbook. Will include auto-revoke, header+cidr allowlist, region routing, rate_multiplier, fallback model/condition, ephemeral pool, and alerts for p95>300ms or 5xx>1%.

marc-ops: ```json
{
  "customer": "sundance-retail",
  "change_request": "CR-2026-1007-sundance-latam-demo",
  "window_start": "2026-10-07T11:00:00Z",
  "duration": "2h30m",
  "rate_multiplier": 3,
  "region_policy": {"preferred": ["sa-east-1"], "fallback": ["us-east-1"]},
  "allowlist": {"header": "X-SD-Auth", "pattern": "^sd_live-[A-Za-z0-9]{6,10}$", "cidr": "192.0.2.128/25"},
  "ephemeral_pool": "small-burst",
  "fallback_model": "sundance-compact-q4_0",
  "fallback_condition": "p95_latency > 360ms for 90s OR 5xx_rate > 1.2% for 2m",
  "alerts": "p95>300ms OR 5xx>1%",
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```

yasmin-eng: LGTM. I'll stage the routing policy and flag the compact variant in the model catalog. Marc — please attach the runbook and include a step to collect request-ids for any fallback hits.

marc-ops: Change request CR-2026-1007-sundance-latam-demo created and pushed to infra. Scheduling auto-revoke at 2026-10-07T13:30:00Z.

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-1007-sundance-latam-demo applied: rate_multiplier=3 (sa-east-1 preferred), header allowlist added for X-SD-Auth, CIDR 192.0.2.128/25 added to accelerator whitelist, ephemeral_pool=small-burst allocated, fallback model sundance-compact-q4_0 enabled with condition p95>360ms for 90s OR 5xx>1.2% for 2m, alerts configured. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-10-07T13:30:00Z.

sara-am: Noted — I'll tag account renewal_flag=medium and schedule a post-demo 1:1. Tori please capture a short customer diary, any auth failures (401/403 counts), and latency samples; we need a quick summary within 12h after the window.

tori-cs: Will collect logs, token failure counts, and sample traces. Will post a concise summary here within 12h after the demo. :memo:
